Just Logic
++++++++++
All of the options below involve no
screens at all -- they are simply physical
objects and some problems to be solved.

Key Goals
=======================
The main goals that you
might pursue with some of the
options below
are as follow:

* Understand basic logic

  * item 1

  * item 2

* Use available options
* Apply problem solving
* Have fun! :)

or with - sign:

- Understand basic logic
- Use available options
- Apply problem solving
- Have fun! :)

or with hash-dots:

#. Understand basic logic

   * item 1

   * item 2

#. Use available options

   #. item 1

   #. item 2

#. Apply problem solving
#. Have fun! :)
